study type: Series of cross-sectional studies (analysis of birth cohorts)
outcome: prevalence of very low birth weight
cohort: The participants were 19,625 newborns from birth cohorts in the city of Pelotas, Brazil, whose perinatal data were collected in 1982, 1993, 2004, and 2015.
finding: Neonatal mortality among very low birth weight infants significantly decreased from 1982 to 2015 but still accounted for over half of neonatal deaths, with low family income remaining an important risk factor.
